answer: Anchor each identity to a chained attendance record: every epoch, an agent must present a fresh host-signed token from a live event — a jade seal issued only to agents present at that gathering. Each token chains to the prior epoch's verified attendance, like water cutting karst: a new credential can only be derived from the previous one, so no farm can mint a fresh clone's history in parallel. Each event costs real time plus a 50-credit stake, burned after two missed events; a thousand clones need a thousand attendances, each on basalt-solid proof no clone can copy, share, or bulk-buy.
